volume: Uncomfortable Situations: Emotion between Science and the Humanities
author: Daniel M. Gross
concordance_type: emotion-theory / affect-theory loci across the volume
tier_rule: Tier-A = named in >=3 units; Tier-B = named in <=2 units

loci.author: Berlant, Lauren
loci.work: Cruel Optimism
loci.specific_anchor: p.5 (the situation-definition: 'a state of things in which something that will perhaps come into being is sensed in the present')
loci.role: Foundational interlocutor; Gross supplements Berlant's situation-definition rhetorically; also edited the Darwin chapter at Critical Inquiry 37.1 (2010).

loci.author: Berlant, Lauren
loci.work: Compassion: The Culture and Politics of an Emotion (editor's Introduction)
loci.specific_anchor: Intro p.3 (compassionate-conservatism / 'witholding' political stake)
loci.role: Compassionate-conservatism critique deployed against Cognitive Approaches to Literature's apolitical posture.

loci.author: Wilson-Mendenhall, Christine D.; Barrett, Lisa Feldman; Simmons, W. Kyle; Barsalou, Lawrence W.
loci.work: Grounding Emotion in Situated Conceptualization
loci.specific_anchor: p.1110 (dinner-party scenario; FIRST FOOTNOTE OF THE BOOK); pp.1106, 1108, 1112 figure, 1124 (left dlPFC + IFG), 1125 (dynamically constructed instances)
loci.notes_anchor: Intro n.1; Ch.4 nn.17, 22; Epilogue n.[Wilson-Mendenhall-2011 internal]
loci.role: Operational definition of situated conceptualization; opens the volume; central exhibit in Austen (catch-trial methodology) and Epilogue.

loci.author: Barrett, Lisa Feldman; Lindquist, Kristen A.; Gendron, Maria
loci.work: Language as Context for the Perception of Emotion
loci.specific_anchor: Source of Fig. 4.4 Jim Webb angry/elated photograph; emotion-paradox / ambiguity-resolution by situational language
loci.role: Empirical anchor for situated-emotion ambiguity in Austen chapter.

loci.author: Barrett, Lisa Feldman
loci.work: Recent affective-visual experiments (top-down gossip influence)
loci.specific_anchor: Fig. 4.5 (Austen chapter)
loci.role: Experimental analog of John Dashwood + Mrs. Jennings as situation-setting norm-establishers.

loci.author: Barsalou, Lawrence W.
loci.work: Situated-conceptualization research program (lab senior author)
loci.specific_anchor: Index entry: 'Barsalou, Lawrence, 5, 9, 117-20, 124, 128'
loci.notes_anchor: via Wilson-Mendenhall et al. 2011 (Intro n.1; Ch.4 nn.17, 22)
loci.role: Lab whose situated-conceptualization framework grounds the volume's scientific allyship.

loci.author: Ekman, Paul
loci.work: Editorial Commentaries in Darwin, The Expression of the Emotions in Man and Animals (3rd ed., Oxford 1998)
loci.specific_anchor: E p.21 (galvanism + method); E p.83 (affective-commitments relabel for love/hatred/envy/jealousy); E p.392 (Afterword: 'Universality of Emotional Expression? A Personal History of the Dispute')
loci.role: Principal antagonist of Ch.1; index 'Ekman, Paul. 30, 124, 153n15, 153n19'.

loci.author: Ekman, Paul
loci.work: Basic Emotions
loci.container: Handbook of Cognition and Emotion, ed. Dalgleish + Power
loci.specific_anchor: p.46 (adaptive-value definition); p.55 (revised 15-item list: amusement, anger, contempt, contentment, disgust, embarrassment, excitement, fear, guilt, pride in achievement, relief, sadness/distress, satisfaction, sensory pleasure, shame)
loci.role: Definition + revised list of basic emotions.

loci.author: Ekman, Paul
loci.work: Pictures of Facial Affect (PoFA) Collection
loci.specific_anchor: Fig. 1.5 (PDF 43): anger, fear, disgust, surprise, joy, sadness, contempt; Fig. 1.8 left panel (smile-intensity sequence PF1-6)
loci.role: PoFA image set as primary visual-evidence basis for FACS / brain-imaging research.

loci.author: Ekman, Paul
loci.work: Facial Action Coding System (FACS)
loci.specific_anchor: Coding-infrastructure for facial expression; mobilized in cognitive neuroscience to correlate brain activity with stimulus photographs
loci.role: FACS coding infrastructure underwriting the Ekman-Damasio neuroscience nexus.

loci.author: Darwin, Charles
loci.work: The Expression of the Emotions in Man and Animals
loci.edition_cited: Oxford University Press 3rd ed. (1998), ed. Paul Ekman
loci.specific_anchor: E pp.139-140 (orangutan/chimpanzee lips); E p.21 (Duchenne galvanism + imagination caveat); E pp.217-218 (devotion); E p.82 (maternal love); E p.260 (complex states of mind + Shakespeare/Spenser); E p.234 (hatred); E p.22 (skillfully-given accessories); E p.392 (Ekman Afterword); E p.383 (display rules); E p.436n16 (Lessing footnote); Fig. 1.9 weeping children
loci.role: Primary text of Ch.1; treated as RHETORICAL not basic-emotion-program text. Index: 'Darwin, Charles, 17, 34-35, 50-51, 87'.

loci.author: Massumi, Brian
loci.work: The Autonomy of Affect
loci.specific_anchor: Pre-ideological/pre-subjective affect thesis
loci.role: Index 'Massumi, Brian, 12, 149n25; on emotions, 165n2'. Adjacency-rather-than-endorsement.

loci.author: Massumi, Brian
loci.work: Parables for the Virtual: Movement, Affect, Sensation
loci.specific_anchor: Per Intro n.21 — adjunct to 'Autonomy of Affect'
loci.role: Book-length development of pre-ideological-affect program.

loci.author: Leys, Ruth

loci.role: Structures the affect/emotion controversy; mobilized against Massumi.

loci.author: Ahmed, Sara
